pictures.name: ASP1-After-The-War
pictures.prompt: A hilltop at dusk in ancient India. the emperor Ashoka (a strong Indian ruler in his forties, a short dark beard, a simple gold circlet instead of a crown, a plain white and saffron robe, a grave, thoughtful face) stands alone, his back half turned, looking out over a vast, empty, quiet plain where the smoke of distant fires drifts away; his sword is laid down on the ground beside him.
